Researcher (the integrator): downloaded on 28 September 2026 (UTC) at 15:01:22Z (plain); 15:01:22Z (cache-busting query); 15:31:58Z (plain), each time with the same byte count and SHA-256. Bytes and SHA-256 are of the identity-encoded body, requested without Accept-Encoding (the Diet API and the Internet Archive send gzip when a client asks for it, which changes the transferred bytes but not the content). rights_note: Factual observations paraphrased with attribution; short quotations only. No photographs, emblems, seals, signatures, scanned pages or long speech text copied. No open license, portrait permission or likeness approval is asserted.
scope_note: The Diet minutes API's JSON for the whole meeting record of the 衆議院 予算委員会 第1号 (1991-08-20), a transcription of the House's printed minutes; the exact API URL whose bytes were hashed is recorded, and the readable minutes page is https://kokkai.ndl.go.jp/txt/112105261X00119910820. The printed page images, served through a JavaScript viewer, were not viewed. Statements are used only where a party officer speaks of the party office. Recorded at meeting level because the party-officer identification and the statement are in different speeches.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: In the House of Representatives Budget Committee on 20 August 1991, 山花貞夫 introduces himself as having become secretary-general at the recent party convention ('さきの党大会で書記長に就任いたしました山花貞夫であります', speech 49; a minister's answer calls him '山花書記長', speech 73) and later says '過日の代表質問で田邊委員長が指摘しましたとおり' (speech 74): a party officer's same-day statement naming 田邊 as chair.

locator.speaker: 山花貞夫 (49, 74); 中尾栄一 (73, calls him 山花書記長)

bounded_scope: Party-office observations of the chair of 日本社会党 (委員長) and, from the January 1996 renaming, the party leader of 社会民主党 (党首), for CLAUDE-C01-29 only, 1990-2026. Party elections and selections, notices, filings, counts and declarations, convention approvals, statements of assumption, in-office attestations, announced, submitted, accepted and withdrawn resignations, stated ends, acting arrangements, predecessor references, the renaming, the 2020 convention decision and retrospective records stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this office (a notice, a schedule, a filing by several candidates, an organization event, an acting leader). The prime-ministership (jp_pm), ministerial and Speaker offices, parliamentary groups and other party offices are excluded: no row feeds them, and none of their claims feeds this office. Organization identities stay unresolved; no row maps or merges 日本社会党, 社会民主党 or any other party.
